evidence.quote: Alicia Monroe, the city's redevelopment coordinator, apologized for the short notice but said the meeting date had been set to keep a state grant application on schedule.
Others questioned Monroe's decision to circulate only a summary of the plan rather than the full draft agreement.
Monroe said the complete materials would be posted before the next workshop and that no final vote had been scheduled.
the meeting ended with residents calling for a different coordinator to oversee outreach.

The Market District Neighborhood Advisory Board voted 7-2 Thursday to express no confidence in redevelopment coordinator Alicia Monroe's public-outreach plan, citing what members described as inconsistent communication and insufficient notice for key meetings.
Monroe said she accepted the criticism and would publish a calendar of meetings, documents, and decision points within two weeks.
Redevelopment coordinator Alicia Monroe presented a revised Market District timeline at Monday's city council meeting, adding two public workshops and extending the written-comment period by 30 days.
